body.name: Typed regular model-index family \(\mathcal Q_T\)
body.construction: \(\mathcal Q_T=\{Q=(P_{0X,Q},\vartheta_Q):Q\text{ induces }P_{\xi,Q}\text{ and }(P_{N,Q})_{N\ge1},\text{ and the induced generic objects satisfy }\text{ass:fixed-horizon},\text{ass:gaussian-interactions},\text{ass:bernoulli-design},\text{ass:gaussian-innovations},\text{ass:primitive-independence},\text{ass:initial-iid},\text{ass:initial-moments},\text{ass:smooth-messages},\text{ass:identified-branch},\text{ass:mean-rank},\text{ass:variance-excitation},\text{ass:path-smoothness},\text{ and }P_{\xi,Q}\in\mathcal U_{\mathrm{rr}}\}\). Each \(Q\) therefore determines both a primitive-row law and a finite-\(N\) array law, rather than identifying a row law with an array-law sequence.
